table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode,   
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationSerialNo,   
	ExpiryIntimation.AccCode,
	AccName = (SELECT AC.Name FROM Accounts AC WHERE AC.AccCode = ExpiryIntimation.AccCode),
	ExpiryIntimation.Date,   
	ExpiryIntimation.UserCode,  
	Amount = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.Qty * D.Price) FROM ExpiryIntimationDetail D WHERE D.IntimationCode = ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode),0), 
	ExpiryIntimation.Posted,   
	ExpiryIntimation.PostDate, 
	ExpiryIntimation.RefNo,
	ExpiryIntimation.Remarks1,
	ExpiryIntimation.Remarks2,
	ExpiryIntimation.Pushed,
	ExpiryIntimation.PushedOn,
	PushedBy=IsNull((Select username from users 
							where ExpiryIntimation.PushedBy = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	PushedFor = IsNull((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.InstanceID + ')' FROM Site S WHERE S.SiteCode=ExpiryIntimation.TargetSiteCode),'')

FROM 
	ExpiryIntimation
WHERE	
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationTypeCode=1
ORDER BY 
	ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode
